scope: Replace Drawpile’s generated RAM and storage values with app-specific estimates for a small dedicated server. Values are estimates; retained session files can grow with use.

estimates.basis: Official docs describe a low-demand dedicated server and support small Linux hosts; range assumes a few concurrent sessions.
